title: Same-parent supersession of a required child: when the successor is a required child of the same parent and is completed, completion validation and the obligations summary recognize that audited resolution as satisfying the original requirement; otherwise show states why a waiver is still owed and shows the successor's state
outcome: Same-parent supersession of a required child: when the successor is a required child of the same parent and is completed, completion validation and the obligations summary recognize that audited resolution as satisfying the original requirement; otherwise show states why a waiver is still owed and shows the successor's state
acceptance: canonical supersession and requirement links are inspected at completion: a required child superseded by a completed required sibling under the same parent and generation counts as resolved for the seal and is not listed as owed; completion validation and show agree, never show alone

where supersession does not transfer the requirement, the owed row displays the successor ref and lifecycle and a one-line reason the waiver is still owed, with the existing waiver remedy; no seal credit is granted from an unrelated completed item

completion.summary: Delivered audited one-hop required-successor seal accounting and matching safe show/list summaries; landed and independently verified.
